summary_of_changes: Added TEST_ONLY_JWT_SECRET to _INSECURE_SECRETS; added ProductionTestModeConflictError, get_effective_env, is_production_env, is_testing_flag_enabled, assert_production_test_isolation, is_isolated_testing_mode; hardened jwt_secret() and assert_runtime_config(); added import-time assert_production_test_isolation() guard.
security_invariant_enforced: Centralized fail-closed rejection of SALES_ENV=production + SALES_TESTING; production never returns test/insecure/short JWT secret; import-time startup guard.

summary_of_changes: Moved app.config import and assert_production_test_isolation() ahead of FastAPI, storage, auth, and router imports; hardened _check_configuration(), _schedule_post_bind_sheets_init(), and CORS checks to use centralized production/test isolation helpers.
security_invariant_enforced: Startup conflict detection runs before API, storage, auth, coordinator, and background workers; test flag cannot bypass config checks or Google Sheets initialization in production.

summary_of_changes: Enforced assert_production_test_isolation() in SheetsDatabase.__init__, start_background_init, init_connection, _assert_direct_mutation_allowed, enable_shared_file_store; guarded allow_in_memory_fallback via __getattribute__/__setattr__; added _get_effective_shared_test_dir() and used is_isolated_testing_mode() in retry backoff.
security_invariant_enforced: Production cannot activate in-memory or shared-file fallback storage; production + SALES_TESTING fails closed on init, reads, and writes; isolated dev testing preserved.

summary_of_changes: Updated validate_coordinator_durability() to resolve env/testing via centralized config helpers, raise CoordinatorDurabilityError(error_code='PRODUCTION_TEST_MODE_CONFLICT') on production + testing conflict, and enforce multi-instance and persistent-path checks unconditionally in production.
security_invariant_enforced: Production cannot bypass persistent coordinator disk checks, volatile-path rejection, or single-instance topology constraints via SALES_TESTING or SALES_TX_ALLOW_VOLATILE_COORD.

summary_of_changes: Added 12 targeted regression tests (including clean subprocess startup-ordering verification) covering all 10 required Mission 1.9R-1 security and compatibility scenarios.
security_invariant_enforced: End-to-end verification of production/test isolation without mocking the guard return value and without modifying or weakening existing tests.
